info.title: GTO Score API
info.description:
GTO Score reads the hand histories of a poker room and scores the decisions of a player against the solver.

Send the access token of your application in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. The guides explain how to get one.

post.description:
Open a GTO Score task.

The request carries no file. Upload the hand histories through the `sign` and `complete` calls of the task.
The scoring starts when `complete` accepts the upload.

`content_type` declares the one kind of hand that the task scores. `nlhe.cash.1` is No-Limit
Hold'em cash and is the default. `plo.cash.1` is 4-card Pot-Limit Omaha cash. Every hand of the
upload must match the declaration: a hand of any other variant or format comes back with
`billable: false` and a reject reason. Upload one kind of hand per task.

## Scope

`scope` picks how many seats of each hand the task scores.

- `player` (the default) scores one seat per hand: the nickname in `player`, or the hero seat of the hand
  when `player` is empty. One hand is one billable unit.
- `table` scores every seat that shows hole cards. Each seat is a solve of its own and a billable unit of
  its own, so a six-handed hand with six known hands costs six units and takes about six times as long.
  `player` must be empty for a `table` scope.

## Authentication

An OAuth2 application token with GTO Score enabled. Contact your GTO Wizard representative to enable it.

One task of an application runs at a time. Open the next task after the running one reaches
SUCCESS or FAILURE.

## Error responses

- `GTO_SCORE_NOT_ENABLED` (403): the application has no access to GTO Score.
- `GTO_SCORE_MONTHLY_LIMIT_REACHED` (403): the application spent its monthly hand limit. A sandbox
  application carries one; a contracted application has none.
- `GTO_SCORE_EFFORT_NOT_SUPPORTED` (400): `effort` is not one of the offered levels.
- `GTO_SCORE_TASK_IN_FLIGHT` (409): the application already holds a task that has not finished.
- 429: the application spent its write budget for the hour. `Retry-After` says when it refills.

get.description:
Read the state of a task and its players table, one page at a time.

This is the polling call of the flow: open the task, upload the hands through `sign` and `complete`, then
poll here until `status` is `SUCCESS` or `FAILURE`.

A `FAILURE` carries the reason in `error_message`. Every other status leaves that field empty.

`billable_units` holds one entry per metric that the task billed. One scored hand is one unit of its
metric, so a hand priced both ways adds one unit to each. `hands_billable` is their sum.

`items` holds one row per player of the task. It is empty until the task ends. `total` counts every player,
so `offset` and `limit` walk the whole table. `order_by` picks the column and the direction.

Every score is in `[0.00, 1.00]`. `1.00` is the best action at every decision.

## Error responses

- `NOT_FOUND` (404): the task does not exist, or it belongs to another application.
- `GTO_SCORE_NOT_ENABLED` (403): the application has no access to GTO Score.
- 429: the application spent its read budget for the hour. `Retry-After` says when it refills.

get.description:
List the scored hands of a task, one page at a time.

The rows are ordered by the time the hand was played. `total` counts every hand of the task that matches
the `player` filter, so `offset` and `limit` walk the whole set.

Every score is in `[0.00, 1.00]`. `1.00` is the best action. A hand that GTO Score could not solve has
`billable: false`, a `reject_reason` and null scores.

## Error responses

- `NOT_FOUND` (404): the task does not exist, or it belongs to another application.
- `GTO_SCORE_NOT_ENABLED` (403): the application has no access to GTO Score.
- 429: the application spent its read budget for the hour. The body names the limit and the window.

get.description:
Read the per-street and per-action scores of one hand.

GTO Score keeps no hand histories, so the answer carries no hole cards, no board and no hand text. It
carries the actions of the scored seat, with the score, the EV loss, the solver frequency and the best
action at each decision. The scores stay readable after the task's hands are purged.

A hand that GTO Score could not solve answers the hand row with its `reject_reason` and no streets.

## Error responses

- `NOT_FOUND` (404): the task or the hand does not exist, or the task belongs to another application.
- `GTO_SCORE_NOT_ENABLED` (403): the application has no access to GTO Score.
- 429: the application spent its read budget for the hour. The body names the limit and the window.

post.description:
Open an export of every scored action of a task.

The paged calls answer JSON one page at a time. This call answers one file instead, so a task of
10,000 hands reaches you in one download. The file holds one row per scored action: the hand, the
street, the action, the EV loss, the GTO score and the solver frequency.

The export is a job. This call answers 202 with an export id, and the file is written in the
background. Poll `GET .../exports/{export_id}/` until `status` is `SUCCESS`, then download the file
through the signed URL in `file.url`.

A hand that GTO Score did not solve has no scored action, so it writes no row. Read the hands list
for the rejected hands of the task.

`format` picks `csv` or `jsonl`. `columns` picks and orders the columns; an empty list writes every
column in the default order.

## Error responses

- `NOT_FOUND` (404): the task does not exist, or it belongs to another application.
- `CONFLICT` (409): the task has not finished, or it already holds an export that is running.
- `GTO_SCORE_NOT_ENABLED` (403): the application has no access to GTO Score.
- 422: `format` is not an offered format, or `columns` names a column that does not exist or repeats one.
- 429: the application spent its write budget for the hour. `Retry-After` says when it refills.

get.description:
Read the state of an export and get the link to its file.

`status` is PENDING while the export waits for a worker, STARTED while it writes, then SUCCESS or
FAILURE. `file` is null until the export reaches SUCCESS.

`file.url` is a signed URL. It carries no credential of yours, it works for one GET, and it stops
working at `file.expires_at`. Read this call again for a new URL.

## Error responses

- `NOT_FOUND` (404): the export or the task does not exist, or the task belongs to another application.
- `GTO_SCORE_NOT_ENABLED` (403): the application has no access to GTO Score.
- 429: the application spent its read budget for the hour. The body names the limit and the window.

GtoScoreUploadFileKind.description:
What one declared file of a task holds.

The two kinds never share a stream. The orchestrator joins every `HANDS` object into one hand
stream and picks the serialization format from its first line, so a JSON sidecar in that stream
would set the format of the whole task to JSON.
GtoScoreUploadFileKind.title: GtoScoreUploadFileKind

task_id.description: The task that the pipeline now scores.
task_id.title: Task Id

status.description: Status of the task at the moment of the answer. The starter moves PENDING to STARTED.

GtoScoreContentType.description:
The one kind of hand that a task scores. The partner declares it when it opens the task.

The `.1` suffix is the version of the scoring of that content. A later change to how GTO Score
scores Hold'em cash arrives as `nlhe.cash.2`, and the partner keeps the earlier contract until
it moves.
GtoScoreContentType.title: GtoScoreContentType

GtoScoreMetric.description:
What a score prices.

`CHIP_EV` prices a decision in chips. It is the only meaning a cash hand can carry, and it is
what the MTT chipEV trees give a tournament hand.

`ICM` prices a decision in tournament equity, through the Independent Chip Model. It needs the
payout structure, the players still in the tournament and the chips they hold, so it needs a
tournament sidecar record for the hand.
GtoScoreMetric.title: GtoScoreMetric
